content:
Random landscape from around A Coruña.
A photo from a walk on 15 June, 2024.
📷 OM-D E-M5 & 45 mm ƒ1.8, shot at ƒ5.6.

photos.alt:
A vertical photo of an uphill view with many elements. In the middle there is a lonely tree on a hillside that is mostly devoid of green grass. Its shadow is right below it, as if the sun was shining from the top.

The frame is divided diagonally by a thick wire going from the top-left corner to the bottom-right. The wire is covered by vines and ends up behind a wooden bench that stands on some concrete platform. The vines on the bottom of the wire are green, and the further up the more dried up and dead they seem to be. In the bottom-left corner of the frame there is a bit of a metallic fence, on the left of the frame there are some green trees visible, and there are also some trees in the background further, but not too far. The sky is almost fully clear and blue, with a single strand of thin clouds going diagonally by a slightly different angle than the wire.
